analytic_contract.conditional_no_go: A smooth finite positive kinetic screening normalization that is growing at u0 cannot keep its active timelike chi-gradient mixing contribution nonnegative for all u>=u0.
not_concluded: The full determinant is negative whenever M is negative.
The current action has no healthy bounded parameter/background domain.
Any covariant completion or alternative gate architecture is impossible.
The metric-scalar-disformal matter system is unhealthy on shell.
analytic_contract.theorem_conclusion: The comparison solution forces q and ln(Z) to diverge by finite t=ln(u), contradicting a smooth finite gate on the entire later unbounded-u interval.
theorem_hypotheses: X>0, beta>0, u=beta*X^2, and Z(u)>0 is C2 for every u>=u0
analytic_contract.timelike_sign_criterion: For X>0 and Z>0, M>=0 iff 4*dq/dt>=q+4*q^2.

bounded_domain_counterexamples.result: M>0 throughout the declared bounded domain
M=0 and Z is smooth and finite on every compact subinterval strictly below the finite blowup boundary
q=0 and M=0; this does not provide a growing kinetic screening gate

family_and_counterexample_contract.p_equals_2_regression: For p=2 the threshold is u=1/3 and the predecessor factor is recovered exactly.

full_determinant_caveat.health_ceiling: A positive local two-scalar determinant is necessary on the frozen slice but does not establish full H3, H4, metric constraints, on-shell existence, global hyperbolicity, or EFT validity.
full_determinant_caveat.interpretation: The theorem constrains the sign of one mixing contribution. A positive P sector or a dynamically suppressed X_chi can retain a positive local determinant on a restricted domain.
full_determinant_caveat.stabilization_if_M_negative: For Z>0, A_phi>0, M<0, and X_chi>=0, D>=0 requires X_chi<=Z*A_phi/(-M).

limitations: The theorem concerns the sign of the mixing contribution on aligned timelike external-metric local jets with an active chi gradient; it is not an unconditional action no-go.
A positive P-sector contribution or a sufficiently suppressed on-shell X_chi can keep the frozen local determinant nonnegative on a restricted domain.
The sign equivalence is for X>0; on X<0 the prefactor reverses and this theorem is not claimed.
Bounded-domain gates can keep M nonnegative before a threshold or finite comparison boundary.
The preregistered alternative architectures have not been derived, screened, simulated, or shown healthy.
Metric constraints, on-shell backgrounds, global hyperbolicity, EFT cutoff, lensing, and observational support remain unresolved.

remedy_preregistration.architecture: Keep the chi kinetic normalization independent of u and place the environmental gate in a covariantly derived chi source or matter coupling.
remedy_preregistration.structural_difference: The Z_X kinetic Hessian mixing targeted by the theorem is absent when the kinetic coefficient is constant.

remedy_preregistration.architecture: Use K(u)*X_chi-H(u)*m_chi^2*chi^2/2 with independently frozen K and H rather than one Z multiplying the full quadratic sector.
remedy_preregistration.structural_difference: K controls the principal mixing while H separately controls the lower-order range; the no-go applies to a growing K and is not automatically cured by H.

remedy_preregistration.architecture: Require the on-shell background dynamics to preserve X_chi<=Z*A_phi/(-M) wherever M<0.
remedy_preregistration.structural_difference: This restricts the active background gradient rather than forcing the kinetic-gate mixing term to remain nonnegative.

remedy_preregistration.architecture: Replace the diagonal Z(u) chi sector with a covariant two-field kinetic metric and an independently frozen cross term designed at the action level.
remedy_preregistration.structural_difference: The relevant Schur complement comes from the full field-space Hessian rather than the single-function M combination.

remedy_preregistration.architecture: Replace propagating chi by an algebraic or explicitly constrained auxiliary channel and integrate it out only after deriving the constraints.
remedy_preregistration.structural_difference: There is no independent chi kinetic eigenvalue or active two-propagating-scalar mixing determinant of the analyzed form.

scope_and_definitions.active_mixing_scope: The physical obstruction from a negative M requires an active timelike chi gradient X_chi>0; X_chi=0 removes this contribution.
scope_and_definitions.determinant_role: On the chi_bar=0 aligned timelike slice, D=Z*A_phi+X_chi*M with A_phi=P_y+2*y*P_yy.
scope_and_definitions.gate_regularity: Z is positive and C2 in u on every analyzed interval
scope_and_definitions.metric_role: fixed external Lorentzian metric in a local inertial patch
scope_and_definitions.physical_branch: aligned timelike local jets with X=X_phi>0, X_chi>=0, and u=beta*X^2>0
scope_and_definitions.sign_scope: For X>0, the prefactor relating M to 4*dq/dt-q-4*q^2 is positive. The equivalence reverses on X<0 and is not claimed there.

The mixing term equals the frozen logarithmic-gate identity.
q=u*w_u converts the mixing bracket into 4*dq/dt-q-4*q^2.
Its denominator vanishes after the frozen finite log-u interval.
The integrated equality gate has the comparison log slope.
The equality gate has M=0 before its finite boundary.
The shifted-power mixing bracket is exact.
p=2 recovers the predecessor u=1/3 factorization.
The full slice is the P sector plus X_chi*M.
The frozen X_chi bound is the determinant-zero boundary when M<0.
